show.description: Chirag Chauhan lives as an ordinary man, hiding the truth that he is the last disciple of the legendary yogi Neeldev. When he saves Nimisha, the fearless chairperson of the Nandini Group, destiny places him as her personal bodyguard. Between power struggles, betrayal, a forced contract marriage, and rising enemies, Chirag must protect Nimisha while keeping his divine identity secret until fate forces him to reveal his true strength.
